worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.summary: Fire a vortex that knocks back the target and damages nearby enemies, with a high critical-hit chance. Charge for greater power and reach, or use the quick-fire variant.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.use.0: Twist the air into a vortex bolt and fire it straight
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.use.1: Detonate an air ring on impact and shove the main target
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.use.2: Strike a target at long range
The vortex strikes a single foe for about %1$s special damage with a %2$s-block hit radius, and has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
It flies straight for %1$s blocks (%2$s blocks per tick) and settles on the first foe it hits, shoving it %3$s blocks along the path.
The hit bursts into a %1$s-block ring; up to %3$s other foes inside take %2$s of the damage.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.charge.on: Charge form: power ×1.18, range +2.5 blocks, vortex body ×1.15 and ring ×1.1, but +6 ticks wind-up, +2 recovery, +14 cooldown and flight ×0.9.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.charge.off: Rapid form (default): flight ×1.12 and 8 ticks less cooldown, but power ×0.94 and slightly shorter range.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the vortex rises to %2$s, range to %3$s blocks and ring radius to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.preference.c: On: power ×1.18, range +2.5 blocks, vortex body ×1.15 and ring ×1.1, at +6 ticks wind-up, +2 recovery, +14 cooldown and flight ×0.9 — for leading a distant target. Off (rapid form, default): flight ×1.12 and 8 ticks less cooldown, but power ×0.94 and slightly shorter range — usable even up close.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. This is the longest-ranged move of the family, so a large value fires first from far away.
On: when a foe drops below four tenths of its health this heavy shot is preferred, to finish it. Off: health is ignored and it ranks as an ordinary ranged move.
